text_block_list.text:
The imaginary reunion took place—
in the underground passage after the race.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for watching, Trainer.
And also...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Along with the other Trainer.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text:
No, thank you, Wonder Acute.
For showing us such a great race.
Wonder Acute showed off her seasoned brilliance in today's race as well. But on top of that—

Today, it felt like she was giving off
a different kind of brilliance as well.
Her acceleration was even greater than usual, too...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer from wherever you are, here's what I think.
Even if Umamusume are total strangers...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Somewhere, somehow, don't you think everything's connected?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The feelings of your Umamusume, I...
today...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I think I felt it while I was running.
Mysterious things really do happen, don't they...

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text: Wonder Acute...

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for those wonderful words.
Even if they were just meant to comfort me...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
As if this is merely cold comfort.
That is why...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta keep moving forward now.
Because I've properly taken your feelings to heart.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text: You are...

Wonder Acute seemed to sense
the deep worries weighing on that Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I'm not trying to replace that girl or anything, but... if you're alright with me...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'll be sure to put on a great run in the big race.
Right before your very eyes, of course.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text: Thank you. If you really feel that way, then I...

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep cheering for you right there in person!
As long as you keep running on the racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ohoho, to think you'd say such a thing~.
Thank you so much, I'm truly delighted.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
To think that even I
could have such a wonderful cheering squad.

Having finished the race—I felt it.
'The bare minimum requirements have been met.'

"There is no longer any barrier separating the Classic and Senior classes.
You can enter any race now."
And—Wonder Acute shouldered countless hopes that rivaled even those of Smart Falcon.
The rest depends on her own feelings—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, honestly, I still can't quite imagine
myself winning. But~

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"What I'm aiming for
is simply 'catching up', you see."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: "What do you think? Isn't it about time you managed to at least bite at their heels?"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Umâto Falco-san.

It seems she has plenty of motivation herself.
As for whether she can actually keep up with them—

There's only one way to find out.
—At Oi, at the end of the year.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...!
Are ya really goin', seriously!?
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's run with Smart Falcon.
Yeah, let's run with Smart Falcon.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: At last... at long last...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Fuho! I'm really starting to get fired up!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'll do it.
I'll show everyone that even someone like me can do it...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"And I'll give them courage.
I will... without fail...!"

I thought I had been taking things without rushing.
Yet looking back—
For Wonder Acute, she was able to make it this far at quite a brisk pace. That's also thanks to her enduring such intense training...

And so, the door to her dream opened—at top speed.
The door to the Tokyo Daishoten,
and her grand showdown against Smart Falcon.
